title: The semibounded Wick cutoff forms have an exact divergent scalar projective cocycle

scalar_cocycle.definitions: On normalized T3 let V_N=integral :phi_N^4: dx and W_N=integral (phi_N^2-3C_N)^2 dx=V_N+6C_N^2
scalar_cocycle.cocycle: b_MN=6(C_M^2-C_N^2) obeys b_LN=b_LM+b_MN and is a scalar vacuum-energy cocycle
scalar_cocycle.exact_martingale_recenter: For W_N+a_N to be an exact martingale, a_N+6C_N^2 must be constant, so the recentered family is V_N plus one constant
scalar_cocycle.semiboundedness_conflict: The martingale recenter has lower bound constant-6C_N^2, which diverges to minus infinity; retaining the nonnegative square instead retains the divergent scalar cocycle
scalar_cocycle.dynamics_note: A scalar shift changes unitary evolution only by a phase, but changes spectral origins and resolvents; the cocycle therefore does not itself prove Hamiltonian convergence
scalar_cocycle.ceiling: The exact scalar conflict proves neither Mosco failure nor strong-resolvent failure after ground-energy recentering, and supplies no continuum domain, interacting BRST closure or source ownership
